answer: Escalating alias fees plus behavior fingerprinting stop cheap sybils. Every new identity pays a fee that doubles per alias tied to the operator, starting at 50 POA, so the tenth alias costs 25,600 POA and mass creation loses money within 3 epochs. The network fingerprints task patterns and timing; two aliases matching on 80 percent of their signature get merged into one relic identity with their staked fees slashed. One violation sends a ripple through the alias set, freezing every alias for 5 epochs, while a violet flag on the merged record warns counterparties before any deal.
